The binary is the CLI. In development run commands from source with `go run ./cmd/app <command>`;
a built binary runs them as `ims <command>`. Global flags work with every command.

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--env-file` | — | path to the env file (default: APP_ENV_FILE or .env) |
| `--verbose` | — | enable debug logging |

### backup:clean

Apply the retention policy to stored backups.

```bash
ims backup:clean [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | — | report what would be deleted without deleting |

### backup:list

List recent backup runs.

```bash
ims backup:list [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | `20` | maximum runs to list |

### backup:monitor

Check backup freshness and storage usage.

```bash
ims backup:monitor
```

### backup:run

Create a database backup archive.

```bash
ims backup:run [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--destinations` | — | comma-separated destinations (local is always included) |
| `--filename` | — | archive filename override |
| `--with-files` | — | include BACKUP_FILES_PATHS in the archive |

### billing:expire-subscriptions

Mark overdue subscriptions as expired.

```bash
ims billing:expire-subscriptions
```

### billing:send-renewal-reminders

Log renewal reminders for subscriptions expiring within 7/3/1 days.

```bash
ims billing:send-renewal-reminders
```

### cache:clear

Clear the configured cache store.

```bash
ims cache:clear [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--store` | — | override the cache driver (memory\|file\|redis\|database) |

### config:show

Print the effective configuration.

```bash
ims config:show
```

### data-processing:cleanup-completed

Delete completed processing-job records older than the retention window.

```bash
ims data-processing:cleanup-completed [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--days` | `0` | retention window in days (default: data_processing_job.cleanup_days setting) |
| `--dry-run` | — | report how many jobs would be deleted |

### gen docs

Render docs/reference/{cli,configuration,permissions,make}.md from the code: the
command tree, .env.example, the permission catalog and the Makefile. With --check
nothing is written and the command fails when a committed page is stale (CI).

```bash
ims gen docs [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
ims gen docs
ims gen docs --check
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | — | fail when a generated page is stale instead of writing it |
| `--root` | `.` | repository root |

### gen module

Generate a goose migration, sqlc queries and a feature-first module package
from a field spec. Non-interactive and CI-friendly.

```bash
ims gen module [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
ims gen module --name=product --fields="name:string,price:decimal,is_active:bool"
ims gen module --name=product --fields="name:string,notes:text?" --dry-run
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` | — | print the files without writing them |
| `--fields` | — | comma-separated name:type spec, e.g. name:string,notes:text? |
| `--force` | — | overwrite existing files |
| `--module` | — | go module path (default: read from go.mod) |
| `--name` | — | module name, lower_snake, singular (required) |
| `--no-openapi` | — | skip refreshing the generated OpenAPI regions |
| `--no-sqlc` | — | skip the automatic `sqlc generate` step |
| `--package` | — | go package name (default: --name) |
| `--root` | `.` | repository root |
| `--table` | — | table name (default: naive plural of --name) |

### gen openapi

Insert or update the generated paths and schemas for one module
(--module), every module in the index (--all), or insert the empty marker
regions (--init). Managed regions are owned by the tool; everything
outside the markers is hand-written and never touched.

```bash
ims gen openapi [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
ims gen openapi --init
ims gen openapi --module=product
ims gen openapi --all --check
ims gen openapi --all --dry-run
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` | — | refresh every module listed in the generated-region index |
| `--check` | — | exit non-zero when the committed regions are stale |
| `--dry-run` | — | print the regenerated regions without writing |
| `--init` | — | insert the empty managed regions (one-time) |
| `--module` | — | refresh a single module (lower_snake name) |
| `--root` | `.` | repository root |

Run application health checks.

```bash

```

### migrate

Apply all pending database migrations.

```bash
ims migrate
```

### migrate:rollback

Roll back the most recent migrations.

```bash
ims migrate:rollback [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--steps` | `1` | number of migrations to roll back |

### migrate:status

Show migration status.

```bash
ims migrate:status
```

### oauth:client:create

Register an OAuth client for the MCP connector.

```bash
ims oauth:client:create [flags]
```

Examples:

```bash
ims oauth:client:create --name "Ops agent" --redirect https://agent.example.com/callback --confidential
ims oauth:client:create --name "Local tool" --redirect http://localhost/callback
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--confidential` | — | give the client a secret (server-side clients) |
| `--name` | — | name shown on the consent page (required) |
| `--read-only` | — | never grant mcp:write |
| `--redirect` | — | redirect URI (repeat for more; https, or http on localhost) |
| `--tenant` | `0` | only this tenant's users may connect |

### oauth:client:delete

Delete an OAuth client and revoke every connection made with it.

```bash
ims oauth:client:delete <id>
```

### oauth:client:list

List the OAuth clients registered for the MCP connector.

```bash
ims oauth:client:list
```

### oauth:client:rotate

Give a confidential OAuth client a new secret (the old one works for MCP_OAUTH_SECRET_GRACE).

```bash
ims oauth:client:rotate <id>
```

### openapi:check

Validate the embedded OpenAPI document (api/openapi.yaml) and compare it
against the live router. Requires database connectivity (the route table is
built from the full dependency graph), like health:check.

```bash
ims openapi:check
```

### permission:sync

Sync the permission catalog into the database.

```bash
ims permission:sync
```

### queue:stats

Show queue depths and failed counts.

```bash
ims queue:stats
```

### queue:work

Start a queue worker (River).

```bash
ims queue:work [flags]
```

| Flag | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--max-workers` | `0` | max workers per queue (default: QUEUE_WORKER_CONCURRENCY) |
| `--once` | — | process due jobs and exit |
| `--once-timeout` | `30s` | how long --once waits for a job |
| `--queues` | — | comma-separated queues to process (default: critical,default,heavy) |

### schedule

Run the scheduler daemon (one process per deployment).

```bash
ims schedule
```

### schedule:list

List registered scheduled tasks.

```bash
ims schedule:list
```

### schedule:run

Run a scheduled task once, immediately.

```bash
ims schedule:run <task-id>
```

### serve

Start the HTTP API server.

```bash
ims serve
```

### settings:sync

Upsert settings groups and insert missing global settings.

```bash
ims settings:sync
```

### version

Print the build version.

```bash

```
